episodes.name: Day 6: 6:00 A.M.-7:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: A new U.S. President has negotiated Jack's release from a Chinese prison so Jack can stop a series of terror attacks... with his life.

episodes.name: Day 6: 7:00 A.M.-8:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Can Jack and an unlikely ally stop a suicide bomber and track the architect of these acts of terror?

episodes.name: Day 6: 8:00 A.M.-9:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Jack and former terrorist leader turned peacemaker, Hamri Al-Assad, track a suspicious man to a self-storage facility.

episodes.name: Day 6: 9:00 A.M.-10:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: While Jack has problems with Curtis, CTU discovers a nuclear threat and raids a terrorist warehouse, and a shocking explosion shakes LA.

episodes.name: Day 6: 10:00 A.M.-11:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Four more "suitcase nukes" are out there, and Jack's only lead takes him to the home of his brother.

episodes.name: Day 6: 11:00 A.M.-12:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Jack finds himself confronting his father while the lead terrorist needs help if he's to explode the remaining bombs.

episodes.name: Day 6: 12:00 P.M.-1:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Family troubles: Jack with his brother and father while Morris worries about his own brother.

episodes.name: Day 6: 1:00 P.M.-2:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: The President meets with a known terrorist, while Jack searches for Morris, Fayed seeks a trigger, and Tom Lennox makes a choice.

episodes.name: Day 6: 2:00 P.M.-3:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Jack looks for a Russian national as his father plots with shadowy patriots. Meanwhile, the President and the Constitution may be in danger.

episodes.name: Day 6: 3:00 P.M.-4:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While Jack looks for Gredenko and tries to save Josh, White House intrigue deepens.

episodes.name: Day 6: 4:00 P.M.-5:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Jack's search takes him to the home of an old enemy, while a bomber slips into the White House.

episodes.name: Day 6: 5:00 P.M.-6:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Jack's search takes him to the Russian Consulate, while the Vice President contemplates a sweeping executive order.

episodes.name: Day 6: 6:00 P.M.-7:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: The search for Gredenko finds Jack hunted inside the Russian Consulate and a former President calling on his ex-wife.

episodes.name: Day 6: 7:00 P.M.-8:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: CTU's satellite tracking system is compromised as a bomb-carrying drone heads toward an unknown city. Meanwhile, US forces prepare for a nuclear retaliation on the Middle East.

episodes.name: Day 6: 8:00 P.M.-9:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Jack enlists the help of an autistic man in the search for Gredenko, and Sandra Palmer makes a fateful decision.

episodes.name: Day 6: 9:00 P.M.-10:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Jack baits Fayed with Gredenko, while the President faces a challenge to his office.

episodes.name: Day 6: 10:00 P.M.-11:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: To find the remaining suitcase bombs, both Jack and the President set up bluffs.

episodes.name: Day 6: 11:00 P.M.-12:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: The Chinese want Jack to give them Russian nuclear technology, and the President wants the Vice President's resignation.

episodes.name: Day 6: 12:00 A.M.-1:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Jack goes rogue to save a woman, and the White House needs a fall guy for Fayed's success.

episodes.name: Day 6: 1:00 A.M.-2:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: A missing computer circuit board: the Russians get wind of Chinese espionage, the White House must find a leak, and CTU interrogates an unlikely witness.

episodes.name: Day 6: 2:00 A.M.-3:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Russian ire worries the White House, while the Chinese take on CTU, and the damaged circuit board is in surprising hands.

episodes.name: Day 6: 3:00 A.M.-4:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Russia presses the White House, while Jack must try to thwart the Chinese and his oldest antagonist simultaneously.

episodes.name: Day 6: 4:00 A.M.-5:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: In order to prevent a war with Russia, the White House orders a trade of Jack's nephew for the circuit board, and puts Jack in custody so he cannot stop the exchange.

episodes.name: Day 6: 5:00 A.M.-6:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Jack rushes toward his nephew and his oldest antagonist, as a Chinese sub and F-18s race for the same destination. Chloe faints. Can Jack find any peace?
